summary: Backend-only testing of SOLD wizard vehicle/purchase bug fix. 13/14 tests passed, 1 skipped (relationship-brief not a public endpoint). All three core fixes verified: PATCH /vehicle partial update, POST /purchases → vehicle field sync, relationship_intel purchase context.

minor.issue: Endpoint not exposed publicly (404). Test skipped. relationship_intel.py tested indirectly via verifying contact.vehicle is populated after purchase, which feeds AI context.

critical_code_review_comments: relationship_intel.py line 284: reads contact.get('vehicle_purchased') or contact.get('vehicle_interest') or contact.get('vehicle') for AI context string. But brief['contact']['vehicle'] already has the correct vehicle_display value (line 75). There's a minor inconsistency: the ai_parts block at line 284 re-reads from raw contact dict instead of brief['contact']['vehicle']. This means if purchase_history has a title but legacy vehicle field is empty, the AI context string (line 286: 'Most recent purchase: {vehicle}') may still be empty. The brief['contact']['vehicle'] (which correctly uses most_recent_purchase.title fallback) is not reused for the ai_parts line. Not a breaking bug but could cause AI to miss vehicle context in edge cases where only purchase_history exists and legacy vehicle field is not set.

sold-quick.tsx line 155: normalizedPhone variable self-references before assignment (const normalizedPhone = ... ? `+${rawDigits}` : normalizedPhone). This will throw ReferenceError at runtime if rawDigits.length is not 10 or 11-starting-with-1. The fallback to `normalizedPhone` is undefined at that point. Should be: `customerPhone.trim()` as fallback.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All vehicle/purchase fix tests pass. PATCH /vehicle partial update works correctly and does not wipe other contact fields. POST /purchases correctly sets vehicle=$set on the contact document. purchase_history is populated and accessible via GET /purchases. One code review note: sold-quick.tsx line 155 has a self-referencing variable bug in the phone normalization fallback (normalizedPhone refers to itself before assignment). This could cause a ReferenceError for phone numbers that are not 10 or 11 digits starting with 1.
rca_of_issue: Root cause was api.put('/contacts/{uid}/{cid}', {vehicle: text}) which sent a partial object to a PUT endpoint expecting full ContactCreate model. All other fields got reset to defaults and likely failed 422 validation silently. Fix: (1) POST /purchases does $set vehicle via $push+$set atomically, (2) PATCH /vehicle does safe partial update, (3) fallback in sold-quick.tsx tries PATCH /vehicle if POST /purchases fails.
